title: Project 4 · Read and validate local tasks
prompt: Import TaskStore from ./store.js and export async function openTitles(store: TaskStore). Call store.read() once. If it rejects, return "unavailable". If the result is not an array, return "invalid". Otherwise return the titles of items that are objects with a string title and done set to false, in order. Skip malformed items. An empty title is still a title.
hints: Wrap the read in try/catch so a rejection becomes an expected result.
Use Array.isArray before treating the result as a list.
For each item, check typeof title and that done is exactly false.
checks: __same(await answer.openTitles(new TaskStore(async () => [{ title: "A", done: false }, { title: "B", done: true }])), ["A"])
__same(await answer.openTitles(new TaskStore(async () => [null, { title: "C" }, { title: 5, done: false }, { title: "", done: false }])), [""])
await (async () => { let calls = 0; await answer.openTitles(new TaskStore(async () => { calls++; return []; })); return calls === 1; })()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats an empty title as missing.
Reports a failed read as invalid data.

feedback: Separate a failed read, data that is not a list, and individual malformed items.
